prompt:
A ship sails 12 km on a bearing of $050^{\circ}$ and then 8 km on a bearing of $140^{\circ}$.

**(a)** Find its distance from the starting point. **[2]**

**(b)** Find the bearing of the ship from the starting point. **[2]**
markscheme:
**(a)** The bearings differ by $90^{\circ}$, so the legs are perpendicular **(R1)**: $d=\sqrt{12^{2}+8^{2}}=14.4$ km **(A1)**

**(b)** Angle at the start between the first leg and the line to the ship: $\arctan\frac{8}{12}=33.7^{\circ}$ **(M1)**; bearing $050^{\circ}+33.7^{\circ}=083.7^{\circ}$ **(A1)**

A sketch with north lines at each point is essential for bearings.

prompt: From point $P$ the angle of elevation of the top of a tower is $30^{\circ}$. From point $Q$, 20 m closer to the tower on the same level line, the angle of elevation is $45^{\circ}$. Find the height of the tower.
markscheme:
Let the height be $h$. Distances to the base: $\dfrac{h}{\tan30^{\circ}}=h\sqrt3$ and $\dfrac{h}{\tan45^{\circ}}=h$ **(M1)(A1)**

$h\sqrt3-h=20$ **(M1)** $\Rightarrow h=\dfrac{20}{\sqrt3-1}\approx27.3$ m **(A1)**

prompt: From the top of a 60 m cliff, the angle of depression of a boat is $25^{\circ}$. Find the horizontal distance from the foot of the cliff to the boat.
markscheme:
The angle of depression equals the angle of elevation from the boat (alternate angles) **(R1)**

$d=\dfrac{60}{\tan25^{\circ}}=129$ m **(A1)**

prompt:
Town $B$ is 5 km due east of town $A$. Town $C$ is 7 km from $A$ on a bearing of $030^{\circ}$.

**(a)** Draw a labelled diagram showing this information. **[2]**

**(b)** Find the distance $BC$. **[2]**
markscheme:
**(a)** North line at $A$; $AB$ along $090^{\circ}$ of length 5; $AC$ at $030^{\circ}$ of length 7; angle $BAC=90^{\circ}-30^{\circ}=60^{\circ}$ marked **(A2)**

**(b)** $BC^{2}=5^{2}+7^{2}-2(5)(7)\cos60^{\circ}=39$ **(M1)**, $BC=6.24$ km **(A1)**
